_README: Human decisions the triage cannot derive, and must never overwrite.
triage_corpus.py rebuilds config/draft/ from scratch on every run, so a decision
that lives only in a generated map is destroyed by the next run. Anything here is
re-applied on every run instead, and appears in review.<country>.md marked [manual].
Only put a decision here when NO rule could reach it. Duplicates, waves and
document types are handled by the triage itself. What belongs here is knowledge
about the world: that two surveys from the same agency are different surveys, or
that a file has been cut down by hand.
exclude  filename (relative to doc_dir) -> reason, printed in the review sheet
note     free text recorded in the map's manual_review block

paraguay.note: The DGEEC publishes several surveys from one page, so the scraper collected instruments that are not the EPHC. No filename or title-page rule can tell that EUT and MICS are different surveys rather than other documents of this one; it takes knowing the survey landscape.

exclude.Cuestionario EUT 2016_Py.pdf: documents the EUT 2016 time-use survey, a different instrument from the EPHC
exclude.Manual_encuestador_EUT_2016 FINAL.docx: documents the EUT 2016 time-use survey, not the EPHC
exclude.CUESTIONARIO MICS PARAGUAY 2016.pdf: documents MICS 2016 (UNICEF multiple-indicator cluster survey), a different instrument from the EPHC

argentina.note: metodologia_eph_continua_2003_sin_anexo2.pdf is a derived document: the original with Anexo 2 removed. It sits in doc_dir and the triage picks it up as an ordinary candidate; only the original needs suppressing. Derivation: qpdf metodologia_eph_continua_2003.pdf --pages . 1-26,63-69 -- metodologia_eph_continua_2003_sin_anexo2.pdf (2026-08-20, 70,179 -> 36,229 tokens). The derived file is pinned to M: it dates to 2003, so the vintage sort plus --max-per-source 4 pushes it out otherwise, which silently undoes the split.

exclude.metodologia_eph_continua_2003.pdf: superseded by the derived metodologia_eph_continua_2003_sin_anexo2.pdf. Pages 27-62 of the original (36 of 69) are Anexo 2, the 2003 questionnaires; leaving them in lets a 2003 form be cited as evidence about the current instrument

mexico.note: Decided 2026-08-20: G is field instruction only - the manual for the person asking the questions. A manual for post-collection data validation cannot evidence how the instrument was designed to ask about gender or care work.

exclude.G_Encuesta_Nacional_de_Ocupación_y_Emple: manual for the crítico-validador role (post-collection data validation), not instruction to the interviewer; G is field instruction only

chile.note: Decided 2026-10-08: the three INE Chile gender documents are institution-wide (sex/gender/orientation measurement standards and mainstreaming guidance), not ENE documentation. The ENE questionnaire and methodology are to be added instead. The ENE glossary (updated 2025-09-26) is pinned to M: no filename rule classifies it, and it defines the survey's concepts.

exclude.informe-de-resultados-diagnóstico-sobre-: INE-wide document on measuring sex, gender and sexual orientation in administrative records; it does not document the ENE, so it cannot evidence how the ENE instrument is designed
exclude.documento-de-seguimiento-de-la-aplicacio: INE-wide document on applying the INE standard for measuring sex, gender and sexual orientation; it does not document the ENE, so it cannot evidence how the ENE instrument is designed
exclude.guia-transversalización-enfoque-genero-: INE-wide document on gender mainstreaming in statistical production; it does not document the ENE, so it cannot evidence how the ENE instrument is designed

ecuador.note: Decided 2026-10-08 in the hand review of the Ecuador map: two M slots held a results report and a recalculation note, while the cap pushed out two INEC methodology documents on informal employment and activity status, which bear on d2_i3.

exclude.empleo_poblaciones_especificas_marzo_202: results report characterising women, older adults and young people in the labour market, not methodology
exclude.M_202106_Nota_tecnica_ENEMDU.pdf: technical note on recalculating the 2020-2021 employment and poverty series; does not document the instrument's design
exclude.202106_Nota_tecnica_ENEMDU.pdf: identical copy of M_202106_Nota_tecnica_ENEMDU.pdf, excluded for the same reason

united_kingdom.note: Decided 2026-10-08: M keeps only User Guide Volume 1 (background and methodology) and Volume 8 (household and family data, 2003), the volumes that bear on the framework. Volume 3 (254,503 tokens) alone outweighed the rest of M and forced sharding. Volume 8 is pinned because, undated by its file name, it never wins a slot under the cap.
